verdict: This deck is a time-machine through music as power technology — from bone flutes to retention algorithms in 48 cards, and almost every stop hits hard. Strongest suit: the lore writing is the best in the corpus; PAYOLA, HILDEGARD'S VISION, THE SILENCE, and THE AMEN BREAK each land a real punch in under two sentences. Weakest: the digital-era tail (Retention Rate, The Playlist, Top 40) describes systems rather than giving you a character to wear. KOMIKA AXIS conspiracy wing on pages 11-12 earns its place. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: 48-card music history iceberg from bone flutes to the Algorithm — every card is a concept worth arguing about. For music nerds, industry cynics, and anyone who knows who got paid when the drummer died broke.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: THE ICEBERG SESSION CARDS – Music History from Bone Flutes to the Algorithm (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

How far down does music actually go before you hit a layer nobody printed on the syllabus?

Forty thousand years ago somebody drilled finger holes into a vulture bone, and the first instrument was already a piece of technology. A twelfth-century nun named Hildegard wrote visionary music and filed it under divine loophole, because a woman composing in her century needed a permission slip the Church could not argue with. In 1969 a drummer cut a six-second break that the whole of hip-hop and jungle would later stand on, and he died broke while the sample paid everyone but him. The tracks you can hum are the tip. The part that explains them got quietly sunk.

This is Social Story Wrestling stacked like an iceberg. Forty-eight cut-and-play cards, ancient to algorithmic, that you pick up, perform out loud with a straight face, and defend while the table decides how deep your version is allowed to go.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Iceberg Core Deck: 48 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards running the full arc from bone flute to streaming feed, featuring THE AMEN BREAK, PAYOLA, and HILDEGARD'S VISION.
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No music theory degree, no canon police, just storytelling, the R/A/F dice driving the chaos, and the one law that every card can claim anything, as long as you hold the room before it calls the bluff.
- The Komika Axis Wing: the conspiracy layer where 440Hz fights 432Hz, where Laurel Canyon and Backmasking each get a card, and where THE SILENCE closes the set as the only act that wins by playing nothing at all.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
This is Volume 01 of Sonic Warfare. Grab it and you are not buying a frozen PDF, you are on the list for the whole dig. Every future volume and expansion that goes deeper down the iceberg lands in your library as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because the history of music is mostly the history of who got paid and who got sampled, and a story you can perform yourself is one that stops getting sold back to you. Broke, or did you already buy the same box set twice? Enter "0" and take it. Print it, cut it, play it loud. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the next cards and sharper mechanics. Free to print, share and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
The chart is only the tip. The iceberg is the part they hoped you would never dive for.
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
